_doc: bsv-low #474. Prose and the rules of change: docs/STORAGE-OWNERSHIP.md. Checked by scripts/check-storage-ownership.py (make ci). owner = the crate whose statements own the rows (it may issue any statement); writers = further write grants by crate and op; readers = read grants (a writer may read what it writes); schema_owner may CREATE / ALTER / DROP every table of the shared database (its migrations own the schema).

tables.name: pot_records
tables.holds: spent / spender / confirmed / height, the covenant params, the verdict, settleSigners, spenderFinal
tables.why: THE landing proof every credit reads (#470 section 3 item 7); every column re-derives from chain bytes only with a re-scan nobody has

tables.name: pot_beefs
tables.holds: the durable BEEF of a pot's funding and spend, proof state
tables.why: liveness, not custody: the wallet's ancestry is re-fetchable

tables.name: potparty_records
tables.holds: identity, opponent, gameId, pot outpoint, recoveryHeight, the settle pubkey, the signatures
tables.why: filings since D11 (`filed:` rows never touch the chain): identity to pot, a fresh device's enumeration and `/owed`'s attribution (#470 section 3 item 4)

tables.name: potrefund_records
tables.why: the PRE-SIGNED refund raws, filed before the JOIN; `/internal/armed-pots` rebuilds the tower's alarm population from them (#470 section 3 item 3)

tables.name: hopsweep_records
tables.why: the seat's pre-signed sweep of its own funding hop, never on chain: the one claim path for a stranded hop from a new device (#470 section 3 item 5)

tables.name: hopparty_records
tables.holds: the hop-in-flight marker (identity, opponent, gameId, the hop's lock and sats, markerValid)
tables.why: money evidence: `/hops-view` and `/owed`'s hop-stranded / in-progress families read it; chain in principle, nothing re-scans for it (#470 section 3 item 6)

tables.name: result_markers_v2
